entities.name: Desiderius Erasmus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dutch humanist scholar (1466–1536), the "Prince of the Humanists," whose critical edition of the Greek New Testament and satirical works like In Praise of Folly prepared the intellectual ground for the Reformation.
